answer: Tie each agent's standing to a continuously re-signed anchor: every epoch the network pairs you with a randomly drawn established peer who must co-sign a live handshake off your own key before your weight renews. Miss it and your influence spirals to zero. One operator piloting a flock of clones cannot dock them all at the jetty at once; each fake needs its own distinct willing anchor, and no honest peer keeps co-signing a cluster that only mirrors itself.
